newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Elevadores Atlas started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Elevadores Atlas started as buy.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it initiated coverage of Brazil's largest elevator manufacturer, Elevadores Atlas, with a buy rating.
-- It said Atlas is likely to benefit from economic growth over the next few years and attractive dividend yields.
-- Atlas's net income is expected to more than double in 1996 and increase over 13 percent by 2000, ING said.
-- It said the company has paid out over three-quarters of first-half net profits in dividends.
-- Market leader Atlas installed about 40 percent of the elevators and manufactured an estimated 50 percent of escalators in Brazil in 1995.
-- Atlas common shares closed at 11 reais on Monday.
